name: aidoctor
description: AIDoctor — the coding harness that removes AI fingerprints from your code. v2.0 ships `/aidoctor:deai` as the headline moat skill: detects the visible AI tells (NOTE/IMPORTANT labels, ASCII section dividers, hedge leakage, self-praise vocabulary, emojis in source) and proposes deterministic fixes. Plus calibrated scoring (errors cap at 69, criticals at 39), `--fail-on=error` default so CI works out of the box, JSONL streaming for jq/grep pipelines, and one-command pre-commit setup. 33 Python rules across 10 categories. Skill packs for Rust/Go/JS/TS/React steer agents at generation time today; tree-sitter scanning for those languages lands in v2.1.
